_doc: Ledger of every recording the sound engine knows about. Built from audio/pilot/LEDGER.csv (round 1) and audio/pilot2/LEDGER2.csv (rounds 2 and 3). 'weaponMatch': 'type' = real recording of the right TYPE of weapon or call (model not identified), 'related' = related sound used as a stand-in or reference only. 'shippable' = the licence allows use on a free educational site with attribution and derived audio (CC BY-SA, NC and ND are false). Nothing is loaded by default: the build lists a recording as present only when the page actually loads it (panel). sha256 of every file re-verified on 2026-10-31.
